gallery.aiCaption: A stylized logo featuring a black arrow shape on a split background of black and purple with cyan accents.
A colony management screen showing infrastructure options like Megaport and Waystation with a distinct purple UI theme.
A ship refit screen displaying the 'False God' Euphoria-class carrier with purple hull and fighter bays.
A fleet management interface showing a grid of various Starlight Cabal ships in a dark purple themed layout.
A battle scene with numerous ships firing bright white beams against a dark space background.
A collection of ship sprites with purple and blue hulls arranged against a swirling nebula background.
